rationale: The assistant correctly tied Er03 to liquid on the controls, gave a safe wipe-dry and power-cycle fix, and advised against opening the hob. After the customer reported it working, it confirmed with sensible hedging ('almost certainly'), added monitoring advice, and limited engineer escalation to a recurrence. No parts were recommended and nothing was invented. One minor point: the first reply gave a lot of contingency detail without asking a targeted question.
questionQuality_note: No questions were needed; the first reply covered the checks.
